_comment: Shared by two places: the counted-up band on the overview page (<bench-band>, `counters` + `cta`) and the scale card at the top of animatebench.html (<bench-hero>, `intro` + `scale`). Numbers reproduced verbatim from the paper figure. Edit here, nowhere else, and both follow. A term with no `value` renders as a label alone - that is how human verification is stated, deliberately without a count. Each term's `sub` is the one line of context under its label;

scale.label: Samples
scale.sub: process-oriented scientific diagrams, drawn from four bodies of published work

scale.label: Animation styles
scale.sub: five Layer 1 styles, with Layer 2 camera work on top of any of them

scale.label: Human-verified
scale.sub: every narrative reviewed for faithfulness to its figure

counters.label: Animation styles
counters.note: five Layer 1 styles, plus Layer 2 camera work on top of any of them
